effortLevels.name: high
effortLevels.description: Balances token usage and intelligence. Use as a minimum for intelligence-sensitive work, or to reduce token spend relative to `xhigh`

effortLevels.name: low
effortLevels.description: Reserve for short, scoped, latency-sensitive tasks that are not intelligence-sensitive

effortLevels.name: max
effortLevels.description: Can improve performance on demanding tasks but may show diminishing returns and is prone to overthinking. Test before adopting broadly

effortLevels.name: medium
effortLevels.description: Reduces token usage for cost-sensitive work that can trade off some intelligence

effortLevels.name: xhigh
effortLevels.description: Best results for most coding and agentic tasks. Recommended default on Opus 4.7
